questions: Did the swelling and bruising begin after an injury to your head, face, or eyes?
Did you lose consciousness or become confused after the injury?
Has your vision become blurred, doubled, or reduced in either eye?
Do you have severe pain when moving either eye?
Do you have severe or worsening headache?
Have you vomited since this began?
Have you had bleeding or clear watery fluid from your nose or ears?
Do you have numbness of your cheek, upper lip, or forehead?
Do you have difficulty opening your mouth or biting normally?
Do you have fever or feel acutely unwell?
Have you recently had a sinus infection or severe nasal congestion?
Are the eyes itchy, and did the swelling begin suddenly after exposure to a new food, medication, insect, or cosmetic?
Have you had difficulty breathing, throat swelling, or swelling of your lips or tongue?
Do you take blood thinners or have a bleeding disorder?
Did the bruising occur without any known injury?

dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Systemic AL (light-chain) amyloidosis due to an underlying plasma-cell dyscrasia, presenting with spontaneous bilateral periorbital purpura (“raccoon eyes”)

ALTERNATIVE 1: Multiple myeloma or another monoclonal plasma-cell disorder with periorbital bleeding

ALTERNATIVE 2: Orbital or periorbital lymphoma

ALTERNATIVE 3: Occult acquired bleeding disorder or platelet/coagulation abnormality
